The LAP Ubertas fixed LED downlight provides versatile and efficient lighting for various indoor spaces. Featuring an attractive brushed nickel bezel, this integrated downlight offers adjustable colour temperature settings, allowing users to select between warm white (2700K), cool white (4000K), or daylight (6000K) to suit any environment. It is fully dimmable, enabling complete control over light intensity. With an IP65 rating, it is particularly suitable for bathroom installations, including Zone 2, providing a reliable and long-lasting lighting solution for domestic projects, boasting a 30,000-hour life.
